research_question: Does high AF density predominantly arise through prolonged episode persistence, rapid reinitiation, or dual coexistence across individual patients?
available_evidence: IRIDIA shows persistence (med 82.1m, 1.2% reinit in 30s); LTAFDB shows rapid recurrence (med 14.6s, 78.8% reinit in 30s); SHDB exhibits intermediate coexistence.
blocker_or_next_step: Fit bivariate mixture models decomposing patient density into episode duration vs interepisode gap hazard.

research_question: Are brief 6-second interruptions of AF physiologically equivalent to prolonged 79-minute periods of sinus rhythm?
available_evidence: Post-AF PMV demonstrates acute electrical recovery (+22.77% elevation, p=5.1e-7) over 15-30m; LTAFDB patients reinitiate before atrial electrical recovery can complete.
blocker_or_next_step: Evaluate whether preceding AF density alters the slope of post-termination P-wave recovery in multi-episode recordings.

research_question: Does AF density associate with left atrial diameter in multi-episode patients when strictly restricted to contemporaneous echocardiograms and BSA adjustment?
available_evidence: Multi-episode beta_D = -13.60 mm (p=0.0089); contemporaneous echo beta_D = +7.77 mm (p=0.3086). The multi-episode contemporaneous intersection (N=28) has not been isolated.
blocker_or_next_step: Isolate the exact N=28 multi-episode contemporaneous subset and test BSA-adjusted models.

research_question: What is the minimum signal quality threshold (bSQI) required to preserve density rank ordering in wearable ambulatory ECG?
available_evidence: Noise Holter shows sinus VCC exceeds true AF under severe noise (N2); NSTDB shows detector collapse at SNR <= 6 dB under electrode motion.
blocker_or_next_step: Inject authentic Noise-Holter N1/N2 noise segments into continuous IRIDIA timelines and quantify density estimation degradation.

research_question: Can longitudinal AF density predict thromboembolic stroke risk in non-CIED ambulatory Holter populations?
available_evidence: None of the 4 available open datasets (IRIDIA, SHDB, LTAFDB, Noise Holter) contain prospective longitudinal stroke outcome registries.
blocker_or_next_step: Requires external prospective registry with adjudicated thromboembolic endpoints (e.g., UK Biobank or clinical trial linkage).
